About this Role:

The Senior Construction Auditor is responsible for performing detailed reviews and analyses of construction applications for payment and professional service invoices on assigned projects and programs. This role focuses on verifying that billed costs are accurate, properly supported, and compliant with contract requirements, applicable policies, and established invoice review and exception-handling procedures.

The Senior Construction Auditor/Compliance Analyst works in a dynamic, multi-vendor environment and supports projects delivered under various construction project delivery approaches. This position requires a solid understanding of construction contracts and invoice processing, along with the ability to identify, document, and communicate compliance issues effectively.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Follow established invoice review procedures, instructions, and exception-handling processes.
  • Read, interpret, and understand construction contract provisions related to invoice processing and payment, translating contract requirements into actionable compliance testing.
  • Demonstrate a working understanding of various contract structures and associated cost controls.
  • Verify that each invoice has all required contractual authorizations prior to approval.
  • Understand the scope of work associated with the construction project being billed and assess whether invoiced costs align with approved scope.
  • Review invoices across multiple vendors and contracts, effectively managing complex and high-volume review environments.
  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships with clients and vendors to facilitate communication and timely resolution of issues identified during the invoice review process.
  • Identify non-compliance issues and clearly document findings and associated cost impacts in a concise and accurate manner.
  • Describe identified issues and request appropriate corrective actions in accordance with established procedures.
  • Maintain complete and well-organized electronic and paper work papers documenting review procedures, findings, reviewed amounts, and payment recommendations.
  • Create, manipulate, and analyze spreadsheets to support invoice reviews, reconciliations, and tracking.
  • Maintain accurate and timely invoice tracking logs to support payment workflows and reporting.
  • Work independently while exercising sound professional judgment, and seek appropriate guidance and clarification when needed.
  • Collaborate effectively with other members of the audit and project team to ensure consistent application of review procedures.

Qualifications/Requirements:

  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience reviewing and/or processing construction invoices or payment applications.
  • Construction contract compliance experience.
  • Previous knowledge of the construction industry.
  • Experience with all construction project delivery methods.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify discrepancies and inconsistencies.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to evaluate complex cost and contract information.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document and explain findings.
  • Strong professional customer service skills and ability to work effectively with clients, contractors, and internal stakeholders.

What’s In It For You:

  • Company-paid life and disability insurance
  • Optional benefits like pet insurance, legal, and supplemental health plans
  • 401(k) with day-one eligibility. You’ll get a 100% match on the first 3% of your eligible compensation and 50% match on contributions between 3% and 5% of your pay.
  • Generous time off: 10 paid holidays and PTO starting at 15 days, growing up to 25
  • Access to Consertus Academy for continuous learning and development

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:

Consertus is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and identities, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected status.

jobs.title: Platform Tester (Back-end Systems) - Canada
jobs.excerpt: As a Platform Tester, you'll safeguard the quality of the core platform behind Intelerad's medical imaging solutions: the services, APIs, integrations, and infrastructure that healthcare providers rely on every day.
jobs.description:
As a Platform Tester, you'll safeguard the quality of the core platform behind Intelerad's medical imaging solutions: the services, APIs, integrations, and infrastructure that healthcare providers rely on every day. Building on a strong testing foundation, you'll own test strategy for platform components, expand automated coverage across back-end and integration layers, and partner with Engineering, DevOps, and Product teams. Together you'll make sure every release is stable, scalable, and ready for clinical environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Test Strategy: Own test planning and execution for assigned platform components and services. Define coverage across functional, integration, regression, and non-functional testing to reduce release risk.

  • Automation & CI/CD Integration: Design, build, and maintain automated test suites for APIs, services, and back-end systems. Integrate them into CI/CD pipelines to shorten feedback cycles and increase release confidence.

  • Integration & Non-Functional Testing: Validate platform behaviour across interfaces and deployment environments. This includes interoperability (e.g., DICOM, HL7), performance, scalability, and upgrade and migration scenarios.

  • Defect Analysis & Resolution: Investigate complex, cross-component issues using logs, data, and system diagnostics to isolate root causes. Partner with engineering teams to drive timely resolution and prevent recurrence.

  • Quality Practice & Mentorship: Contribute to platform testing standards and quality metrics. Guide Software Testers on platform testing approaches, tooling, and best practices.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • 5+ years of experience in software testing or quality assurance, including experience testing integrated, multi-service, or platform-level systems, or equivalent experience.

  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining test automation frameworks for API and integration testing.

  • Working knowledge of SQL, test management tooling (e.g., qTest, Zephyr), and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience testing within containerized or cloud-based environments (e.g., AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Demonstrated ability to lead test strategy for complex releases with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

  • Experience with performance and load testing tools for distributed systems.

  • Healthcare IT or medical imaging domain knowledge (e.g., PACS, RIS, DICOM) is a plus.

  • ISTQB certification or equivalent.

jobs.title: Cloud Architect
jobs.excerpt: We're looking for an experienced Cloud Architect to join our organization.
jobs.description:
We're looking for an experienced Cloud Architect to join our organization. In this role, you will be responsible for the architecture, governance, and cost-effective operation of Ergomed's Cloud (Microsoft Azure) environment. This hands-on role leads the design of new and improvements to existing Azure projects, builds reusable deployment templates and standards, and provides architectural review across the tenant — collaborating with project teams on solution design and standards, with IT stakeholders on demonstrable compliance (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA), and with IT Operations on day-to-day support

  • Lead the architecture of new and existing Azure projects, recommending solutions and reviewing designs to ensure strong, repeatable foundations tailored to meet organizational requirements and business objectives
  • Analyze current infrastructure and applications to identify optimization opportunities, cost reduction strategies, and migration pathways to cloud environments
  • Drive improvements in Azure cost management: cost drivers, budgets and alerts, Advisor reviews, and reservation/commitment strategies.
  • Build and maintain reusable project templates and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) modules so new workloads are provisioned consistently and correctly.
  • • Lead the identification and resolution of architecture gaps, risks, and blockers surfaced through ongoing tenant review, working with relevant teams to close them.
  • Develop, implement and maintain cloud governance frameworks, security policies, and compliance standards to ensure adherence to industry regulations and organizational standards
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including DevOps engineers, security specialists, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into solution architectures that meets Ergomed's cloud standards and updating those standards where required
  • Lead the identification and resolution of architecture gaps, risks, and blockers surfaced through ongoing tenant review, working with relevant teams to close them.
  • Define and maintain tagging, naming, and subscription-structure standards, driving their consistent adoption across the tenant.
  • Work with IT Security and workload teams to achieve and maintain demonstrable compliance (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA), putting the right controls in place so compliance status can be evidenced at any time.
  • Evaluate and recommend cloud technologies, tools, and services that align with organizational needs, including containerization platforms, orchestration systems, and infrastructure-as-code solutions
  • Oversee cloud infrastructure deployments, ensuring scalability, reliability, and disaster recovery capabilities are properly implemented and tested
  • Establish best practices for cloud resource management, including monitoring, performance optimization, and automated provisioning
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to development and operations teams on cloud architecture patterns and cloud-native application design

**Required Qualifications:**

  • Extensive experience in IT infrastructure, systems engineering, or cloud architecture, with significant hands-on experience designing and running Azure environments.
  • Demonstrated experience in a cloud architecture or senior technical role
  • Deep, hands-on Azure architecture expertise: landing zones, management groups, networking, identity, storage, compute, and security.
  • Proven ability to design and build reusable deployment templates using Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Bicep, Terraform, ARM).
  • Strong understanding of Azure cost management: cost drivers, budgets and alerts, reservations/savings plans, and Azure Advisor
  • Experience defining and enforcing cloud governance frameworks: Azure Policy, management groups, RBAC, and tagging/naming standards.
  • Experience maintaining compliance against frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA, including control implementation and audit evidence.
  • Ability to translate architectural designs into operational requirements, working with IT Operations on support models.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of resolving complex cloud infrastructure issues.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, able to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical audiences.
  • Familiarity with GxP and GAMP5 frameworks, and experience supporting regulated (validated) cloud systems.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  • Experience with multi-cloud strategies and hybrid cloud architectures
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes and container orchestration platforms
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
  • Experience with cloud cost optimization and FinOps principles
  • Experience with serverless architectures and microservices design patterns
  • Background in enterprise application migration and modernization projects

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Clinical trials, safety studies, and audits make safe and innovative pharmaceutical-led care possible. As part of Ergomed Group, you help patients benefit so they experience more of life’s meaningful moments. Biopharmaceutical companies are our clients. Patients are our purpose.

Ergomed Group brings together Ergomed CRO, PrimeVigilance, Prudentia, and ADAMAS Consulting to help biopharmaceutical companies develop, deliver and safeguard therapies in oncology, rare disease and other complex areas of medicine. Across the Group, our teams turn the signals that clinical trials, safety systems and quality data generate into insight that helps bring safer treatments to patients around the world.

The science and analysis that guides our work is demanding. And this is where we excel. What defines us, though, is how we work together. Across countries, cultures and time zones, we bring kindness, curiosity and a shared sense of purpose to work that genuinely matters. Ideas are welcome here. Growth is expected. And every person has room to make a real difference to patients' lives.

Whether you are early in your career or bringing decades of experience, we want you to feel valued for what you do and for who you are. If that sounds like the place you have been looking for, we would love to hear from you.

About Scale Media

For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding.

Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands.

We believe the best decisions come from data, curiosity, and continuous learning. We value high ownership, candid feedback, and thoughtful execution. As a fully remote company, we lead with clear communication, accountability, and trust, and we give people real room to grow and make an impact.

Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company.

If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in.

The Role

We're looking for a Director, Growth to lead our paid acquisition team and raise the bar on performance across our portfolio of DTC wellness brands.

We expect Meta and paid social to be our biggest growth levers. You'll bring deep platform expertise and the drive to be in the numbers every day: reading performance, spotting what changed and why, and working with the team on what to do about it. You'll set the standard for how we buy media, make sure every platform gets clean, complete data, and make our media buyers sharper every week. You'll also allocate budget across channels against the CAC, ROAS, and MER targets we set.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You won't be setting up campaigns or launching ads yourself, but you'll be in the accounts daily, diagnosing problems and helping make the calls on account architecture, bid strategy, audience strategy, and budget pacing. You'll work closely with Creative, Ecommerce, and Analytics, and help us build AI-enabled workflows that make our media buying faster and sharper.

You'll report to the VP of Growth.

What You'll Own

  • Daily performance management. Reviewing performance every day across brands and channels, catching issues and opportunities early, and driving the team to act on them.
  • Leading the paid acquisition team. Managing and developing our media buyers: reviewing accounts with them, pressure-testing decisions, and building their judgment.
  • Media buying standards. Setting and raising the bar on how we buy Meta and paid social: account architecture, bid strategy, audience strategy, and budget pacing.
  • Platform data quality. Making sure we send the right data into every platform: pixels and Conversions API firing correctly, the right event parameters, and audience exclusions set up properly.
  • Landing pages, creative, and copy. Working with media buyers, Creative, and Ecommerce to decide which pages to launch and where creative and copy need to improve.
  • Budget allocation. Allocating and pacing budget across paid channels to hit the CAC, ROAS, and MER targets set with the VP of Growth.
  • Testing. Running a structured test roadmap across audiences, offers, landing pages, and campaign settings, and turning results into clear next moves.
  • Performance reads. Working with Analytics to read performance through MTA and lift testing, and acting on what the results show.
  • AI-enabled workflows. Using AI tools and automation to speed up reporting, analysis, creative tagging, and optimization.
  • Agencies and vendors. Managing agency or vendor support where relevant.

What Success Looks Like

  • Double-digit new customer revenue growth while hitting brand and product-level efficiency targets
  • Scaled Meta and paid social spend across brands
  • A daily performance rhythm where problems are caught and fixed in days, not weeks
  • Clean, consistent account structures that are easier to scale and diagnose
  • Reliable platform data, with no pixel/CAPI event or audience gaps
  • A media buying team that makes stronger decisions on its own
  • Faster testing velocity, with a clear backlog and documented learnings
  • A higher hit rate on new landing pages, creative, and copy

What We're Looking For

  • Deep Meta and paid social expertise. You've personally managed 8-figure Meta spend for consumer brands, know the platform inside out, and have a playbook on how to scale without losing efficiency that adapts as the platform evolves.
  • Drive to be in the numbers every day. You look at performance daily because you want to, you notice when something moves, and you don't rest until you understand and address it.
  • People leadership. You've managed media buyers and made them measurably better through direct feedback, account reviews, and clear standards.
  • Tracking fluency. You understand pixels, Conversions API, event parameters, and audience exclusions well enough to spot problems and specify fixes.
  • Cross-channel budget experience. You've allocated budget across more than one paid channel and can make tradeoffs between them.
  • Conversion and creative judgment. You can look at a landing page, ad, or piece of copy and say specifically what will improve performance.
  • Testing discipline. You design clean tests, read results honestly, and know when a learning is real.
  • Analytical strength. You're comfortable working through performance data, attribution gaps, and the limits of platform-reported numbers.
  • AI fluency. You actively use AI tools to speed up analysis, reporting, and execution.
  • Cross-functional partnership. You work well with Creative, Ecommerce, and Analytics without adding unnecessary process.
  • 7–10 years of relevant experience, including managing media buyers.

Strong candidate backgrounds include:

  • Meta or paid social leads at scaled DTC brands
  • Senior media buyers who have managed a team of buyers
  • Agency paid social leads who've run large ecommerce accounts

Preferred, but Not Required

  • Experience with TikTok or other paid social channels
  • Hands-on Google Search, YouTube, and Performance Max experience
  • Experience in supplements, wellness, beauty, or consumer subscription businesses
  • Experience operating across multi-brand portfolios

What We Offer

  • Excellent medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
  • Fully remote, full-time position
  • Monthly WFH stipend
  • Generous paid time off program

jobs.excerpt: About DeweyLearnDeweyLearn exists to help organizations preserve and scale expert judgment.
jobs.description:
About DeweyLearn

DeweyLearn exists to help organizations preserve and scale expert judgment. We believe the most valuable knowledge in any organization doesn’t live in manuals or policies, it lives in the decisions experts make every day. Our platform captures that expertise, transforms it into scalable AI systems, and applies it to authentic assessment, coaching, certification, quality assurance, and any workflow where human judgment matters.

DeweyLearn is an AI-powered human assessment and evaluation platform. Our multimodal system analyzes audio and video of real learning, training, and coaching sessions using observational frameworks developed with domain experts, then turns what it sees into structured insight for assessment, coaching, certification, and quality assurance. Our partners span higher education, corporate training, clinical practice, and K-12 education.

DeweyLearn won the GSV Cup grand prize at the 2026 ASU+GSV Summit as the world’s best edtech startup, and recently closed a Series A led by SJF Ventures.

Tasks

About the role

You own end-to-end product management across existing verticals, new verticals, and internal tooling. Working with the Head of Product, you take a focused approach to understanding the problem, and building, validating, launching, and improving a solution that people actually use. Use cases might include a nursing simulation workflow, a repeatable solution for an existing customer need, or an internal tool that helps our team deliver faster.

This is a hands-on building role. You use agentic tools to compose existing DeweyLearn and third-party capabilities, configure workflows, and test working solutions. You partner with Customer Success and domain experts to understand the use case, and with Engineering and Product Delivery to deliver it successfully. You own the assigned product’s outcomes, then take on new opportunities as the solution becomes repeatable, and ongoing ownership is clear.

Requirements

What you'll do

Understand the use case: Partner with Sales, Customer Success, customers, and domain experts to identify the problem, current process, and evidence of value.

  • Build the complete solution. Configure workflows, prompts, evaluation frameworks, and integrations using existing capabilities and agentic tools. Work with Engineering when platform changes are needed.
  • Validate in real use. Test the full customer or internal workflow against agreed quality criteria, review failures with relevant domain and technical owners, and iterate.
  • Launch and drive adoption. Coordinate readiness, onboarding, and handover with Product Delivery. Partner with Customer Success and Product Marketing on demos, enablement, and feedback.
  • Own the outcomes. Track useful adoption, quality, time to first value, and commercial contribution. For internal tools, demonstrate time savings, improved throughput, or reduced errors.
  • Make it repeatable. Reduce bespoke setup and support, build reusable workflows, and turn user learning into product improvements and roadmap input for the Head of Product.

About the Candidate

  • Curiosity and adaptability: You learn new domains quickly and recognize when to involve specialists or engineers. You can move between industries and internal use cases while staying focused on outcomes. Experience in education, assessment, workflow automation, integrations, or AI evaluation is helpful, not required.
  • Agentic building: You use AI tools to build working solutions, inspect outputs critically, troubleshoot failures, and improve them. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you enjoy making things work.
  • Ownership and judgment: You can show useful things you have built and shipped, and explain your decisions and results. You may be early in your career; demonstrated ownership matters more than years in a PM title. Personal, academic, internal, and customer projects all count.
  • Customer-close learning: You seek out users and domain experts, test assumptions in real workflows, and turn what you learn into concrete changes. You follow through beyond a demo and communicate tradeoffs clearly.

What this role is not

  • Not a role with a ready-made playbook—you won’t always have a defined roadmap, established tools, or an existing solution. The Head of Product sets priorities; you take ownership of figuring out how to achieve the outcome.
  • Not a coordination-only role — you build working solutions and own product outcomes, rather than only writing specs or tracking delivery.
  • Not a solo engineering or domain-expert role — you work hands-on with agentic tools while partnering with customers, Customer Success, specialists, Engineering, and Product Delivery.

How we hire

We care about what you can do and how you think, not where you've done it. We're hiring for talent that amplifies the team. We evaluate candidates on concrete examples, demonstrably deep knowledge, and real work samples — and on the judgment and self-direction that come from having done work like this before, without a manager scripting the moves.

The team you're joining

DeweyLearn is a small, close-knit team, moving fast, with a deep conviction in the impact DeweyLearn can have on learning and learners. We emphasize fun and a high level of collaboration, while holding each other accountable to our shared outcomes. We hire on ability and judgment, not pedigree, and we trust deeply once we do. We bias toward straight talk, deliver on what we said we would, and treat play and curiosity as part of how the team discovers what to build. We refuse to ship work we wouldn't be proud of.

Benefits

Compensation & logistics

Medical benefits and flexible PTO. Remote-first, with occasional travel for customer visits and team events.

DeweyLearn, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit and business needs. The Company does not unlawfully discriminate against, nor does it tolerate unlawful harassment by any person, on the basis of race, color, religion or creed, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, sex, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected under federal, state, or local law.

At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are hiring a Senior Security Engineer, dedicated to Product Security Incident Response. In this role, you will lead and architect Snowflake's product-integrated Incident Response strategy, with a primary focus on AI and LLM security. You'll design, plan, and drive the implementation of incident response capabilities across Snowflake's AI product surface - including Cortex AI, Cortex Agents, Snowflake Intelligence, and the data pipelines that power them.

AS A SENIOR SECURITY ENGINEER, INCIDENT RESPONSE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

  • Secure modern AI-native codebases operating across multi-cloud environments - including container-based inference services, RAG pipelines, vector stores, and agent orchestration layers.

  • Design and manage response capabilities built into Snowflake's AI operational infrastructure - from model serving endpoints to Cortex Search indexes and Snowpark ML pipelines.

  • Lead with data, code, and automation - build tooling that accelerates detection and response for product security incidents at Snowflake scale.

  • Drive meaningful security outcomes for the customers and enterprises trusting Snowflake with their most sensitive data and AI workloads.

  • 5+ years of experience in information security, primarily in incident response, security engineering, or product/application security (preferred).

  • Experience leading or actively building an application or security engineering program, with a clear point of view on securing AI/ML systems.

  • Experience with threat modeling and security testing across AI attack surfaces, including prompt injection, indirect injection, model inversion, embedding extraction, and supply chain attacks on AI dependencies.

  • Familiarity with the unique data governance and security challenges introduced by LLMs, RAG architectures, and agentic systems.

  • Working knowledge of cloud-native environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and the threat landscape specific to SaaS and AI platforms.

  • SQL proficiency, plus experience building automation and tools with common programming languages (Python preferred).

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate security risk into actionable guidance for product teams.

  • Empathy for developer experience, helping AI engineers ship securely rather than slowing them down.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

  • Experience securing AI/ML infrastructure, including model serving, vector databases, embedding pipelines, API gateways, and LLM-integrated application architectures.

  • Experience building agentic incident response capabilities, including skills, agents, and pipelines.

  • Understanding of current attacker TTPs, including emerging AI-specific techniques such as adversarial ML, agent manipulation, and LLM jailbreaking in enterprise contexts.

This is a chance to do incident response at the frontier of AI security, on products that thousands of enterprises rely on. Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. About the team

What you’ll do

As a Payments Fraud Investigator, you’ll play a critical role in safeguarding our financial ecosystem by investigating high-risk accounts and identifying various forms of fraud. You’ll conduct deep-dive analyses of merchant accounts, lead cross-functional projects, and collaborate with stakeholders to enhance our fraud detection and prevention strategies at scale. Your expertise in fraud patterns and typologies will be essential to developing and enhancing investigative processes and programs.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze high-risk accounts to identify fraudulent merchants, card testing, account takeovers, and other fraud vectors
  • Lead root-cause analyses to identify gaps in current systems, policies, and strategies, and determine enhancements and process improvements to address emerging fraud risks in collaboration with key stakeholders
  • Drive cross-functional projects aimed at refining operational processes and tools and enhancing the detection and management of fraudulent accounts across our global analyst network
  • Investigate, mitigate, and remediate urgent fraud incidents, such as card testing and account takeover, and manage user responses to high-urgency, distributed fraud attacks
  • Communicate regular updates during team and organization-wide business reviews, summarize the outcomes of complex investigations for executives, and deliver clear case determinations to users and partner financial institutions
  • Travel to vendor locations to conduct analyst training sessions and knowledge-sharing initiatives, identify challenges, and enhance analyst performance to improve overall outcomes

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of experience conducting complex investigations
  • 3+ year of experience leading risk-related projects and initiatives and collaborating effectively with cross-functional stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage data to propose solutions to both tactical and strategic challenges
  • A proactive approach to challenging the status quo, with a willingness to question existing processes and advocate for improvements
  • A user-centric perspective when addressing challenges, balanced with a pragmatic and solutions-oriented mindset
  • Ability to travel to vendor locations for up to 10% of the year

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience mitigating digital or card-not-present fraud in payments, e-commerce, social media, or fintech
  • Experience investigating and mitigating card-testing and account-takeover attacks
  • Experience designing fraud and risk workflows, analyst tooling, processes, and procedures

About Nexus Mods
Established in 2001, Nexus Mods is the largest video game modding platform on the internet and a household name in the PC gaming ecosystem.
  • 78M+ registered members
  • 900K+ mods for 5,000+ games
  • 25B+ mod downloads
We’re currently focused on product modernisation, driving growth and building infrastructure for the next 10 years of community-powered modding.

Our Role
We're looking for two experienced Senior Backend Engineers to join the engineering team behind Nexus Mods' core services. You'll design, build and scale the APIs and systems that power the Nexus Mods ecosystem, working on problems most companies never see: massive scale, complex compatibility and passionate user communities.

From discovery and experimentation through to delivery and scale, you'll be hands-on in shaping features that directly impact the modding ecosystem. Your focus may evolve over time, but areas you could work on include:

Keeping our community safe and supported
  • Moderation and support tools, and user-facing features that resolve issues faster.
  • Security features such as malware detection, authentication (2FA, login, account recovery), API protection, rate limiting and user data protection.
  • Compliance and legal requirements, including child safety legislation, GDPR and cookie compliance.
Helping our platform and business grow
  • Improving how users experience value and become paying supporters, through upsells, pricing localisation and onboarding.
  • Building the foundations for community growth, such as creator partnerships and new audience acquisition.
  • Admin tooling, dashboards, marketing integrations and data tools that teams across the company can rely on.
Core platform and ecosystem
  • Helping millions of gamers discover, download and manage mods, and empowering creators to publish and manage their work with confidence.
  • Building high-traffic APIs serving millions of requests per hour, for both web and desktop applications.
  • Tackling complex challenges around dependencies, versioning and compatibility.
  • Improving performance, scalability and reliability, and addressing technical debt so we're ready for the next decade of growth in gaming.

Role Requirements

  • Deep experience with at least one backend language (Ruby, PHP, Java, Go, Node.js, etc.) and curiosity to learn others.
  • Experience designing and building APIs (REST and/or GraphQL).
  • Solid experience with relational databases (Postgres, MySQL) and familiarity with NoSQL stores (Redis, Elasticsearch).
  • Experience with distributed systems, queues and event-driven architectures, plus production experience with performance optimisation and caching.
  • Hands-on experience deploying services with CI/CD pipelines and containers (Docker/K8s).
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to balance speed, quality and pragmatism.
Bonus skills
  • Familiarity with Ruby on Rails.
  • Knowledge of authentication, identity management and payments.
  • Experience with search systems (Elasticsearch, Meilisearch) or with trust and safety and compliance-driven engineering.
  • Experience building tools for creators, modding communities or user-generated content platforms.
  • Passion for games and mods, whether that's tweaking Skyrim load orders, building Minecraft servers or diving into mods.

Role Responsibilities

  • Own significant backend domains, designing, building and maintaining scalable, secure services and APIs that support tens of millions of users.
  • Break down complex product requirements into clear technical plans and lead delivery of multi-sprint initiatives.
  • Collaborate closely with other engineering teams to deliver end-to-end features.
  • Contribute to product discovery by prototyping, validating feasibility and surfacing trade-offs early.
  • Improve observability, reliability and operational standards, and drive best practice in performance, database design and security.
  • Write clean, well-tested code, uphold high standards across CI/CD and documentation, and mentor other engineers.

Benefits of Working at Nexus Mods

Benefits
  • We work a 4-day week of 32 hours, with no reduction in pay.
  • An allowance of £25 each month to spend on video games.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Private BUPA healthcare for you and your family.
  • A very flexible training budget.
  • Regular social events throughout the year. Participation is optional!
Diversity and Inclusion
We celebrate diversity and want you to bring your whole self to work.
Supporting an incredible community of tens of millions of users, we thrive on engaging as many views as possible to improve our platform. We see no reason why our culture should be any different.

As a BDM, you will own the end-to-end sales cycle—from initial outreach and discovery to closing and onboarding—while consistently creating value and fostering lasting client relationships.

We will give you 50+ warm inbound leads per month. Your job? Own them. All the way.
From discovery to close, from "not now" to "let's revisit", your success will come from your grit, discipline, curiosity, and accountability. We're looking for high-performing Account Executives who are obsessed with results, coachable to the core, and treat every lead like gold.

Key Areas of Impact and Focus:

Core Responsibilities:
  • Own the full sales cycle from inbound discovery to follow-up, closing, and successful onboarding, ensuring a smooth transition for new clients and hitting quota monthly
  • Run 15+ discovery calls per week with C-level and Director-level prospects; uncover pain, establish urgency, and align the right product
  • Know when to position which Magic product by becoming a true product expert and match offerings to prospect needs with precision
  • Treat every lead like a win waiting to happen by working “not now” leads with discipline and creativity until the timing is right
  • Work every deal to completion and don’t let momentum die; follow up persistently, update next steps, and never lose track of potential
  • Own your pipeline like a pro while keeping HubSpot clean, prioritize outreach, and maintain deal velocity at all times
  • Collaborate with Sales, Support, and Ops Teams to ensure clients start strong and are set up for long-term success
  • Share what’s working and learn what’s not bringing a growth mindset to every deal, and adapt quickly when SOPs, experiments, or strategies evolve
  • Continuously learn and improve, seeking feedback, applying it fast, and treating personal growth like part of the job
  • Stay consistent, stay hungry while showing up with energy, drive, and the mindset that every day is an opportunity to win

What Winning Looks Like:
  • You handle 2 to 8 discovery calls per day and never drop the ball
  • You don’t let soft “no's” die. You work the deal until the answer is final
  • You actively ask, “What could I do better?” and apply the feedback fast
  • You own your pipeline like you personally paid for the lead. Every lead, every stage, is tracked and followed up on
  • You’re not waiting for opportunities, you’re creating them in your pipeline

Who This Role is Not For:
  • You blame the leads, the tools, or the process, rather than asking what you could do better
  • You need a manager to tell you what to do every day
  • You think leads manage themselves and don’t believe in persistent, proactive follow-up
  • You don’t take the initiative to improve; you wait for someone to tell you what to fix
  • You treat “bad timing” or “not now” as dead ends instead of future wins to nurture

Qualified Candidate Requirements:

Qualification Requirements

  • Experience Fit: 2+ years of B2B sales experience (SMB/Mid-Market, U.S. or Canada), with a proven track record selling SaaS, subscription services, AI, or outsourcing to executive-level buyers.
  • GTM Fit: You’ve thrived in high-volume inbound environments and treat every lead with the tenacity and structure of an outbound opportunity (no stone left unturned).
  • Sales Style Fit: You’re a consultative, relationship-first seller who drives urgency, uncovers pain, and positions value across multiple stakeholders.
  • Mindset Fit: Hungry, gritty, coachable, self-accountable, and you take ownership of outcomes and don’t wait to be told what to fix.
  • Culture Fit: You thrive in a fast-changing startup, are mature, proactive, curious, and a driver of team momentum.
  • Tech Fluency: You’re strong with HubSpot, AI tools, and modern sales platforms, using technology to go faster.
  • Start Date: You can start on February 9, 2026

Key Time Zone Schedule Requirements

  • Work Schedule: 9-hour shifts following US business hours between 9:00 AM - 8:00 PM Eastern Time
  • Training Schedule: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM Eastern Time (mandatory attendance)
  • Time Zone Alignment: Must be able to consistently work in Eastern Time, including adjustments for Daylight Saving Time
  • Availability: Monday to Friday, with consistent availability during U.S. business hours

Equipment Requirements (Self-Provided)

  • Computer/laptop meeting company specifications
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection (minimum 50 Mbps download/10 Mbps upload)
  • Professional headset for clear client communication
  • Quiet, distraction-free work environment
  • Backup power/internet solution for uninterrupted client service

Traits of a Top Performer at Magic Sales Team

  • Hunger: You chase results and hate leaving potential on the table
  • Grit: You keep pushing when it gets hard because that’s where wins happen
  • Coachability: You treat feedback like fuel
  • Maturity: You treat leads like gold and time like your most valuable asset
  • Ownership: You drive your own success; you don’t wait for it
  • Problem Solver: You look for paths forward, not reasons it won’t work

Application Process

  1. Apply - Application + Video Questions
  2. HR Interview - 1 on 1 with HR
  3. 2nd Level Interview - 1 on 1 with Sales Leadership
    • We may have a 3rd interview with an additional sales leader
  4. Role Play Exercise - 1 on 1 with Sales Leadership
  5. Final Interview - Team-Based Interview

Why Top Sales Performers Choose Magic

Limitless Earning Potential

  • Guaranteed Base: $1,500 - $2,500 monthly foundation for stability
  • Performance Commission: 15-25% increasing with performance excellence
  • Average Commission Reality: $1,500 - $2,000 monthly (what most BDMs earn)
  • Total Monthly Earnings: $2,500 - $4,500+ with clear path to increase
  • Truly Uncapped Commission: Our top performers consistently earn $5,000+ monthly
  • Accelerated Growth: Commission percentages increase as you exceed targets
  • Rapid Advancement: Clear path to senior roles with enhanced compensation

Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Sr. Program Manager, Talent Development

About the job

This position is needed to build and lead the live learning experiences that shape how Twilions grow, lead, and work together. You will design and facilitate Twilio's development programs, design and lead leadership team offsites, and serve as an internal coach to leaders and emerging talent around the globe.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Talent Development, you will spend most of your time in the room, virtual or in person, with Twilions: designing programs, facilitating sessions, guiding leadership teams through high-stakes offsites, and coaching leaders through pivotal growth moments. The ideal candidate is an expert facilitator and credentialed coach who designs with rigor, reads a room in real time, and turns every session into measurable behavior change.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Design and build facilitated development programs end to end, from needs assessment and learning objectives through facilitator guides, participant materials, and experiential activities, for leaders, managers, and individual contributors globally.
  • Facilitate Twilio's development programs in person, virtually, and in hybrid formats, delivering engaging, inclusive sessions that build skills and shift behavior across a global, remote-first workforce.
  • Design and facilitate leadership team offsites and team effectiveness sessions, partnering with senior leaders to define outcomes, build agendas, guide strategic conversations, and drive clear commitments and follow-through.
  • Serve as an internal coach to leaders and high-potential talent, delivering one-on-one and team coaching engagements and embedding coaching into development programs to reinforce learning.
  • Build internal facilitation capability by developing and certifying a bench of facilitators, and set the design and delivery standards for Talent Development programs.
  • Partner with HRBPs and business leaders to diagnose capability gaps and determine whether training, coaching, or a facilitated team intervention is the right solution.
  • Measure the impact of programs, offsites, and coaching through participant feedback, behavior change, and business outcomes, and use the data to continuously iterate.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in Organizational Development, Industrial-Organizational Psychology, Adult Learning, Education, or a related field preferred.
  • 7-10 years in talent development, with 7+ years designing and facilitating leadership, manager, and professional development programs.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and facilitating executive and leadership team offsites, including strategic planning, team alignment, and team effectiveness sessions.
  • Expert facilitation skills across in-person, virtual, and hybrid formats, with the ability to engage diverse global audiences and navigate challenging group dynamics in real time.
  • Strong instructional design skills grounded in adult learning principles, including building facilitator guides and programs that scale through train-the-trainer models.
  • Executive presence with the ability to build trust quickly, deliver candid feedback, and maintain strict confidentiality with senior leaders.
  • Experience using learning and coaching data, including feedback, behavior change, and business metrics, to demonstrate impact and drive program decisions.
  • Willingness to travel for in-person programs and offsites (approx. 25%).

Desired:

  • Certification in assessment tools such as Hogan, DiSC, MBTI, or 360-degree feedback instruments.
  • Experience building an internal coaching program or a facilitator certification pathway.
  • Experience applying AI tools to accelerate program design, personalize learning, or extend the reach of coaching.
  • Ability to effectively prioritize a full facilitation and coaching calendar in a fast-paced, ever-changing culture.

Location

This role will be remote,but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you will travel regularly to facilitate in-person programs and leadership offsites (approx. 25%).

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

*Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.

.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $128,560.00-$160,700.00..
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $136,000.00-$170,000.00..
  • Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $151,120.00-$188,900.00.
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until 10/14/26, but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster.
jobs.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

We're hiring Senior Quality Engineers to join Veeva, building mission-critical software for the global Life Sciences industry across pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and medical devices.

As part of our Quality Assurance and Release Engineering team, you will drive functional and automated quality across cutting-edge, complex systems—ensuring high reliability and customer success with every release.

What You'll Do

  • Design and execute multi-platform test strategies covering native mobile (iOS), Windows desktop/web, and hybrid environments to ensure consistent user experience across all surfaces
  • Create comprehensive testing documentation, including test plans, automated scripts, risk assessments, and detailed bug reports for fast-paced release cycles
  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to automate features and maximize regression coverage across modern web and mobile platforms
  • Mentor junior Quality Engineers in QA methodologies, automation design patterns, and debugging strategies
  • Develop deep technical and domain expertise across Veeva’s suite of industry-leading products
  • Collaborate daily in a fast, agile team environment with software engineers, product managers, and cross-functional partners
  • Test and validate quality across complex, multi-agentic modules—tackling some of the most challenging non-deterministic edge cases and architecture patterns in today’s software landscape

Requirements

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in software quality engineering, software development, or test automation
  • Strong expertise in QA methodologies, automated testing frameworks, and short-cycle software releases
  • Hands-on experience writing and maintaining automated test suites covering sanity, boundary, negative, concurrency, and compatibility scenarios
  • Proven experience in mobile testing across iOS and Android platforms, including native app, hybrid, and mobile web test execution on real devices and simulators/emulators
  • Experience with Windows application and cross-browser testing, including compatibility validation across OS versions, screen resolutions, and hardware configurations
  • Hands-on experience with device testing strategies—managing device farms, physical device labs, or cloud-based device platforms (e.g., BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, AWS Device Farm)
  • Strong technical background in Unix/Linux command-line environments for log analysis and backend debugging
  • Proficiency with SQL for database querying and data validation
  • Hands-on experience with API testing tools (e.g., Postman, REST Assured)
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Must be located in the PST/MST timezone

Nice to Have

  • AI-Native QA Mindset: Experience utilizing AI testing tools, prompt engineering for test-case generation, LLM output evaluation, or generative AI to optimize testing workflows
  • Experience authoring automated tests in standard functional frameworks (e.g., Cucumber, Selenium, TestNG)
  • Mobile automation expertise: Hands-on experience with Appium, XCUITest (iOS), Espresso (Android), or equivalent frameworks for end-to-end mobile test automation
  • Windows & desktop automation: Familiarity with WinAppDriver, Playwright for Windows, or similar tools for automating Windows application testing
  • Proficiency with device management platforms such as BrowserStack App Automate, Sauce Labs, or Perfecto for scalable multi-device coverage
  • Familiarity with SaaS delivery models, CI/CD pipelines, and Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence)
  • Prior experience in the Health Sciences or Life Sciences domains
  • Experience working effectively within distributed/remote teams

Interviewing with Veeva

    We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

  • Base pay: $80,000 - $150,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. Pay, benefits and more.

jobs.excerpt: Hi, thanks for checking out our job board!  If you're an entrepreneurial-minded builder who loves to work with great people to solve wicked problems that have a meaningful impact, read on to see if this position might be a good fit for you!
jobs.description:
Hi, thanks for checking out our job board!
If you're an entrepreneurial-minded builder who loves to work with great people to solve wicked problems that have a meaningful impact, read on to see if this position might be a good fit for you!

⚡ What we’re doing

We are on a mission to eliminate bottlenecks and revolutionize the food and beverage CPG supply chain by developing innovative, all-in-one software that starts with the contract manufacturer.
Contract manufacturers and contract packagers (collectively, co-packers) are facilities that have extra production capacity and provide their services for a fee to customers (brands). Co-packers play a vital role in the trillion dollar U.S. Food and Beverage (F&B) Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry, providing a range of services to convert raw materials into finished goods. These facilities are responsible for blending, drying, baking, frying, forming, and milling raw materials into bottles, pouches, cans, and other packages for our favorite foods and drinks. They are vital businesses for all food and beverage brands, including the thousands of emerging food and beverage brands that lack the resources to handle manufacturing on their own.
We’re building vertical B2B SaaS for F&B manufacturers to run all aspects of their daily operations from estimating costs and ordering raw materials to tracking inventory, managing communication with food and beverage brands, and automating production tasks. Our platform consolidates fragmented software systems and streamline workflows both internally within their business, and externally as they collaborate with their brand customers.

👬 Who we are

Our founding team is no stranger to the complexities of the F&B industry. Our CEO Crawford launched coffee-focused beverage brands and began advising numerous CPG brands and manufacturers. He has lived and breathed the supply chain and manufacturing problems in the food and beverage industry as both an entrepreneur and investor. Our CTO Soheil has 6+ years of experience as a senior software engineer and tech lead at Amazon AWS and Google, across the full stack of software development and scaling and leading engineering teams. And, we're not alone.
We've raised $1M from Bienville Capital and have a team of advisors ranging from industry veterans and consultants.
We believe that our team is our greatest competitive advantage and take pride in having a team of exceptional humans. As a team, we value integrity, customer obsession, bias for action, lean product development, ownership and accountability. If this sounds like you and you're excited by the idea of getting in at the ground level to be part of building the infrastructure that will power the future of the food and beverage industry, we would love to hear from you!

✅ Who you are

We are building out our early engineering team with well-rounded, resourceful, full-stack engineers who want to create a product literally from the ground up. You are someone who loves building products that delights users. An ideal candidate for this role is not afraid to work on any part of the stack from infrastructure to front-end and is excited about the breadth of responsibility and autonomy. You are someone who people can depend on to get things done and take responsibility for your commitments. You love working alongside smart and talented people who are action oriented.
🌟 You’ll be responsible for
As a founding engineer, you will be working closely with our CTO and CEO to understand the product strategy and lead software development using lean and agile methodologies. You will be involved in all aspects of the software development process, architectural decisions, recruiting and building the organization in general. This is a unique opportunity for someone who likes to both dive deep on the technical side and zoom out to collaborate with the executive team on setting a strategic future.
You will work across the full stack, designing and implementing modular systems with the right balance of structure and flexibility, building solutions that enable positive user experiences and meet the business needs of our pilot and future customers.

Requirements

This role sits at the intersection of healthcare law, regulatory compliance, and rapid business growth. You'll work directly with our legal counsel, physician leadership, and Brand Partner operations to maintain the structural separation and Fair Market Value principles that keep our entire ecosystem compliant.

Tasks

Regulatory Compliance & Monitoring:

  • Monitor federal and state healthcare regulations affecting MSO structures, Corporate Practice of Medicine (CPOM) doctrine, Anti-Kickback Statute, Stark Law, and telemedicine requirements across all 50 states
  • Track OIG advisory opinions, CMS guidance, DEA regulations for controlled substances, and state medical board updates
  • Maintain compliance calendar tracking regulatory deadlines, license renewals, and credentialing requirements
  • Conduct quarterly compliance audits of Brand Partner agreements, IMG structures, and payment methodologies

  • Review and validate Fair Market Value (FMV) compensation structures for physician services
  • Coordinate with independent third-party valuators to establish and document FMV rates
  • Audit payment flows to ensure outcome-independent compensation (prescribe vs. no-prescribe scenarios)
  • Document safe harbor compliance under 42 C.F.R. § 1001.952(d)(1) for all MSO arrangements

State-by-State Compliance:

  • Maintain compliance matrices for CPOM requirements in strict states (CA, TX, NY, IL, OH, NJ)
  • Track state-specific telemedicine regulations and physician licensing requirements
  • Review state medical practice acts and corporate structure requirements
  • Coordinate with state healthcare attorneys on jurisdiction-specific issues

Documentation & Agreement Review:

  • Review Brand Partner Agreements, Management Services Agreements, and Business Associate Agreements for compliance
  • Ensure clinical autonomy provisions are properly documented and maintained
  • Audit physician employment agreements within IMG structure
  • Maintain compliance documentation library and audit trail

Physician Credentialing & Licensing:

  • Oversee 50-state physician licensing and credentialing processes
  • Track DEA registrations for controlled substance prescribing authority
  • Monitor medical malpractice insurance coverage and limits
  • Coordinate with IMG medical director on physician compliance issues

Brand Partner Compliance Support:

  • Develop compliance guidance materials for Brand Partners on marketing claims, HIPAA requirements, and prohibited activities
  • Conduct onboarding compliance training for new Brand Partners
  • Investigate potential compliance violations and recommend corrective actions
  • Provide guidance on structural separation between business and medical operations

Reporting & Risk Management:

  • Prepare quarterly compliance reports for executive leadership
  • Identify compliance risks and develop mitigation strategies
  • Maintain compliance metrics dashboard (audit findings, license expirations, agreement renewals)
  • Coordinate with external healthcare law firms on complex compliance questions

Requirements

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Legal Studies, or related field
  • 5+ years of healthcare compliance experience, preferably with MSO structures, physician groups, or telehealth companies
  • Deep understanding of Corporate Practice of Medicine doctrine, Anti-Kickback Statute, Stark Law, and HIPAA regulations
  • Experience with state-by-state healthcare regulatory variations and multi-state compliance
  • Proven track record conducting compliance audits and developing compliance programs
  • Strong understanding of Fair Market Value methodologies in healthcare arrangements

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Healthcare Administration (MHA), Public Health (MPH), or related field
  • Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC) or Certified Professional Compliance Officer (CPCO)
  • Experience with telemedicine regulatory compliance and Ryan Haight Act requirements
  • Background working with private equity healthcare transactions or MSO structures
  • Experience with physician credentialing and state medical board regulations
  • Familiarity with OIG advisory opinions and healthcare fraud enforcement trends

Skills & Competencies:

  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to identify compliance risks before they materialize
  • Strong analytical skills to interpret complex healthcare regulations and apply to business operations
  • Excellent written communication skills for policy development and compliance documentation
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with legal, medical, and business operations teams
  • Comfort with ambiguity and ability to develop pragmatic compliance solutions in evolving regulatory landscape
  • Project management skills to coordinate multi-state compliance initiatives
  • Proficiency with compliance management software, document management systems, and Excel for tracking/reporting

Experience Indicators:

  • Successfully managed compliance programs through regulatory audits or investigations
  • Developed and implemented compliance policies that balanced legal requirements with business objectives
  • Built relationships with healthcare attorneys, external auditors, and regulatory consultants
  • Navigated state-specific healthcare regulations in multiple jurisdictions simultaneously

  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options

Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web. It’s the lead developer of the Espresso Network, the first base layer built from the ground up to provide rollups with the functionality they’ve always needed but never had: fast, secure finality for users’ transactions and seamless composability with other rollups.
Rollups today rely on infrastructure that wasn’t built with them in mind, resulting in their isolation and the fragmentation of users, developers and liquidity within the Ethereum ecosystem. This prevents rollups from achieving the seamless composability that’s essential to web3's vision. Espresso solves this by providing rollups with secure, real-time visibility into what’s happening on all integrated chains, including their own, empowering the apps to execute crosschain interactions immediately without waiting for slow settlement or trusting centralized sequencers.
The Espresso Network is currently live on mainnet in its initial release. In addition to fast confirmations and data availability, rollups seeking further decentralization can also opt to use the Espresso Network as a decentralized sequencer. As the first purpose-built base layer for rollups, Espresso supports a fast-growing ecosystem of interconnected chains regardless of tech stack, VM, or settlement layer—from established chains like Celo and ApeChain to emerging app-specific chains attracting their first users.
At Espresso Systems, we work with leading teams developing rollups and innovating around interoperability, including Offchain Labs, Polygon, Caldera, AltLayer, Cartesi, Across, Hyperlane, and beyond—all united in our mission to build a unified, composable ecosystem where rollups are free to achieve their full potential regardless of where they choose to settle.
The Espresso team comprises a diverse and passionate group of contributors from around the world. We are developers, designers, and researchers who have contributed in academia, open-source communities, policymaking, and beyond. We have raised roughly $60 million from leading investors in technology and crypto, including a16z, Greylock Partners, Electric Capital, Sequoia Capital, and Polychain Capital.

Relay engineers thrive in a high-growth, high-velocity environment where success depends on the highest levels of communication, code quality, and pragmatism. Each engineer must be able to individually own a slice of the Relay codebase while also maintaining a working knowledge of others. Accordingly, Relay is looking for team members who are not only highly-skilled individual contributors but also strong collaborators and communicators.

Technical Responsibilities

  • Facilitate technical growth for all members of the development team
  • Develop, shape, and maintain technical processes and workflows
  • “Set the tone” in terms of craftsmanship standards and code quality
  • Carefully implement critical UI components, shared functionality, and certain subsystems (like monitoring, testing, validation, etc)
  • Rapidly implement functional UI elements from design mocks and workflow diagrams, with an eye toward correctness and readability.
  • Active/thoughtful participation in discussions surrounding ticket specification, design review, etc.
  • Participate in active, intentional, and thorough code reviews.

Lead Responsibilities

  • Actively participate in GitHub discussions, issues, and pull requests
  • Provide technical support and guidance in both GitHub and Discord
  • Participate in growing the development team

Requirements

  • 5+ years building production, customer-facing React applications.
  • 7+ years of experience building production, customer-facing frontend applications (using React or any other frontend toolchain).
  • 1 year of TypeScript experience
  • Minimum 3 years working with any strongly typed programming language
  • Minimum 1 year leading or 2 years contributing to a web3-centric project
  • Very strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Very strong understanding of idiomatic UI implementation patterns
  • Deep understanding of JavaScript and TypeScript
  • Strong understanding of the browser programming environment (the DOM, data-fetching APIs, storage APIs, sessions, HTTP, caching, etc).
  • Working understanding of public key cryptography (encrypting, signing, etc) and associated user flows
  • Desire to work in a semi-public-facing role as an OSS maintainer
Relay's benefits include unlimited and encouraged time off, 100% company-paid medical, dental, & vision for you and your dependents, 2-3x/week company lunches at local restaurants, and for remote employees: up to $2,000 USD home office setup stipend (all benefits are subject to applicable taxes and based on eligibility).

Marktplatz + SaaS-Plattform + Fintech

Über Fresha

Fresha ist das führende KI-gestützte Betriebssystem, dem Millionen von Verbrauchern und Unternehmen weltweit vertrauen. Über 130.000 Unternehmen und mehr als 450.000 Stylisten und andere Fachkräfte weltweit nutzen Fresha und haben bisher über eine Milliarde Termine abgewickelt.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web.
jobs.description:
Espresso Systems builds foundational infrastructure to power tomorrow’s internet, where digital assets are able to move across chains as easily as info flows across the web. It’s the lead developer of the Espresso Network, the first base layer built from the ground up to provide rollups with the functionality they’ve always needed but never had: fast, secure finality for users’ transactions and seamless composability with other rollups.
Rollups today rely on infrastructure that wasn’t built with them in mind, resulting in their isolation and the fragmentation of users, developers and liquidity within the Ethereum ecosystem. This prevents rollups from achieving the seamless composability that’s essential to web3's vision. Espresso solves this by providing rollups with secure, real-time visibility into what’s happening on all integrated chains, including their own, empowering the apps to execute crosschain interactions immediately without waiting for slow settlement or trusting centralized sequencers.
The Espresso Network is currently live on mainnet in its initial release. In addition to fast confirmations and data availability, rollups seeking further decentralization can also opt to use the Espresso Network as a decentralized sequencer. As the first purpose-built base layer for rollups, Espresso supports a fast-growing ecosystem of interconnected chains regardless of tech stack, VM, or settlement layer—from established chains like Celo and ApeChain to emerging app-specific chains attracting their first users.
At Espresso Systems, we work with leading teams developing rollups and innovating around interoperability, including Offchain Labs, Polygon, Caldera, AltLayer, Cartesi, Across, Hyperlane, and beyond—all united in our mission to build a unified, composable ecosystem where rollups are free to achieve their full potential regardless of where they choose to settle.
The Espresso team comprises a diverse and passionate group of contributors from around the world. We are developers, designers, and researchers who have contributed in academia, open-source communities, policymaking, and beyond. We have raised roughly $60 million from leading investors in technology and crypto, including a16z, Greylock Partners, Electric Capital, Sequoia Capital, and Polychain Capital.
As a DevOps Engineer, you will assist the development team in building infrastructure to support production of the sequencer software, as well as build tooling for the deployment of test networks.

Responsibilities

  • Monitoring and management of cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Assisting with CI/CD pipelines and general code management practices
  • Develop and maintenance of tooling for deployment of Espresso Systems services

Requirements

  • Experience working with containers in hosted environments
  • Experience with Terraform or other similar declarative cloud operations technologies
  • Comfort working in the Linux command line

Preferred

  • Experience with Ansible, AWS container orchestration, Docker, Github Actions, Nix, Rust, and Terraform

Benefits

  • Fully remote with flexible hours
  • Work alongside the brightest minds in the crypto space
  • Competitive salary + equity package
  • Regular team off-sites to international locations
  • Unlimited vacation policy
  • Top-tier health, dental, and vision coverage for US employees
